meta.name: baoyu-format-markdown
meta.description: Formats plain text or markdown files with frontmatter, titles, summaries, headings, bold, lists, and code blocks. Use when user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout. Outputs to {filename}-formatted.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给纯文本或 Markdown 文件添加标题、摘要、加粗等格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速美化文章或笔记的排版
copy.tagline_en: Add titles, summaries, bold, and more to plain text or Markdown files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly beautify the layout of articles or notes

howto.what: 把纯文本或 Markdown 整理成结构化文档：补上标题、摘要等头部信息，用加粗、列表、代码块等重新排版，再自动调整中英文空格与标点，另存为“原文件名-formatted.md”。
howto.when: 当你要求“格式化 Markdown”“美化文章”“添加格式”等，或想改进文章排版时触发。

say.text: 把这篇笔记格式化一下，加上标题和摘要。
美化这个 Markdown，把我的重点加粗并列成清单。
say.note: 会先询问是否优化排版，然后处理。

say.text: 只帮我修排版标点和空格，不要改结构。
say.note: 对应“仅修正排版”选项，直接改原文件。

howto.what_en: Reformats plain text or Markdown into a structured document: adds frontmatter (title, summary), applies bold, lists, code blocks, fixes CJK/English spacing and punctuation, and saves as 'filename-formatted.md'.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to format markdown, beautify an article, add formatting, or improve article layout.

say_en.text: Format this note and add a title and summary.
Beautify this Markdown, bolding key points and making lists.
say_en.note: Asks whether to optimize, then processes.

say_en.text: Just fix spacing and punctuation, don't change the structure.
say_en.note: Typography-only option modifies the original in place.
